documents.title: Message from Dan
documents.text: Hi Sara, the 3 p.m. client call is moved to 4 p.m. Can you bring the updated contract? Thanks!

questions.prompt: Why did Dan send the message?
questions.explanation: The call is moved from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m.

questions.prompt: What is Sara asked to do?
questions.explanation: Dan asks: 'Can you bring the updated contract?'

documents.title: Sales Manager wanted
documents.text: Harbor Foods seeks a Sales Manager. Requirements: five years of sales experience and fluent English. Send your résumé to jobs@harborfoods.example before March 1.

documents.title: Application
documents.text:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Sales Manager position. I have worked in sales for six years and speak English and Spanish fluently. My résumé is attached.
Best regards,
Mark Ruiz

questions.prompt: What is the deadline to apply?
questions.explanation: The ad says to apply before March 1.

questions.prompt: How many years of experience does the ad require?
What can be inferred about Mark Ruiz?
questions.explanation: He has six years of experience, more than the five required.

questions.prompt: Which language does Mark speak besides English?
questions.explanation: His e-mail says English and Spanish.

questions.prompt: In the e-mail, the word 'attached' in line 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'Attached' here means enclosed with the message.
